PSB Academy – One of Singapore's Leading Private Education Institutions
Advance in your professional development journey with PSB Academy and be industry-ready at the end of your programme. Our six schools – which include School of Foundation Studies, School of Business and Management, School of Engineering and Technology, School of Health and Life Sciences, School of Postgraduate Studies and Digital Academy – will equip you with the necessary skills to take you places.
Serving students from over 50 nationalities, PSB Academy provides part-time and full-time
degree and diploma courses
, focusing on what really matters in our approach to education. Covering a comprehensive
rang

across different

, explore how our qualifications may help you get where you want to be in your career.
Why PSB Academy?
PSB Academy stands out as one of the leading private institutes in Singapore, renowned for its commitment to delivering quality education and career-focused programmes. With an emphasis on student success, the academy offers an environment that fosters personal and professional growth, equipped with industry-relevant skills and experiences.
Global Academic Partnerships
At PSB Academy, we partner with globally recognised universities to offer students the opportunity to earn international qualifications.
Wide Range of Courses
The academy offers a broad selection of certificate, diploma, degree, and postgraduate courses across various disciplines, meeting industry demands.
Flexible Learning Options
PSB Academy provides full-time, part-time, and online learning options, offering flexibility for students to balance their education with other commitments.
Industry-Ready Curriculum
The academy’s curriculum is designed to equip students with practical, up-to-date skills, preparing them for the global workforce.
Focus on Employability
Soft skills like leadership, management, and problem-solving can be a key deciding factor when applying for a job. Our
leadership
development and
mentoring
programmes focus on developing your character and interpersonal skills to help you stand out from the rest.
Career Development and Support
PSB Academy offers comprehensive
career
services, including resume workshops and annual career fairs, to support students’ transition into the workforce.
Enriching Campus Life
To complement your education in Singapore, you can join
student clubs
for a holistic experience at PSB Academy. To learn more, get started on our
virtual campus tour
or feel free to chat with our students about the
campus life
here.
Well-Equipped Learning Facilities
The academy offers modern classrooms and laboratories, providing students with a conducive environment and opportunities for hands-on learning.
Diverse and Inclusive Community
With a student body from over 50 nationalities, PSB Academy fosters a rich, diverse community that enhances global learning experiences.
Accreditation and Recognition
PSB Academy has earned multiple awards, reflecting its commitment to academic excellence and quality education.
Enrol in P

[P000-C02] https://psb-academy.edu.sg
SB Academy Today
Discover your path in Singapore's tertiary education with PSB Academy, offering certificate, diploma, degree, and postgraduate programmes tailored to different learning needs and flexible study options, including full-time, part-time, and online options. Learn more about our offerings in partnership with established
university partners
from Australia, New Zealand, and the United Kingdom. Contact us today—we’re here to support your education journey.
Frequently Asked Questions
Are there scholarships available for students at private education institutes?
Yes, many private education institutes (PEI) in Singapore offer
scholarships
and financial aid options. It’s important to check with the institution you are applying to for specific opportunities.
What types of courses are available for tertiary education in Singapore?
PEIs in Singapore offer a wide range of courses across different levels of tertiary education, including foundation
certificates
diplomas
undergraduate degrees
, and
postgraduate
qualifications. These courses are often designed with industry relevance in mind and provide flexible study options to suit various academic backgrounds and career goals.
How long does it take to complete a degree at a private education institute?
At PSB Academy, selected degree courses may be completed within 8 to 48 months, subject to the university’s approval and specific course requirements.
How can I fund my studies?
Funding options for students include
scholarships
and
education loans
. You can also explore course funding support options available at various institutions.To know more about our funding, visit us at PSB Academy’s
course funding support
